summary.text: Review and update your household information whenever there are changes to your household.

steps.name: Submit changes
steps.text: Please submit the changes via the MediShield Life e-Service (https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg) and click “Login to access the MediShield Life e-Service”.

example_phrasings: When should I review and update my household information?
How often should I update my household details?
When do I need to update my household info?

sources.page_title: When should I review and update my household information?

quotes.text: You should review and update your household information whenever there are changes to your household (e.g. when you/your household member(s) move house and updated the NRIC address, or when there are new additions to your household).
Please submit the changes via the MediShield Life e-Service (https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg) and click “Login to access the MediShield Life e-Service”.
